sources_used: web search (regional Taiwan/Thailand maimai locators, venue socials)

findings.name: Sould Park Jump Santander
findings.evidence_quote: A trampoline park with an arcade zone. Games list only Mario Kart Arcade GP 2. Visitor: from pics doesn't look like they have any rhythm games tho.
findings.note: Family trampoline FEC; ZIv inventory is non-rhythm only. No ALL.Net/locator hits.

findings.name: Space Ilusiona (Diagonal Mar)
findings.evidence_quote: A ton of ticket machines and kiddos stuff, and just 3 worthy arcades... Inventory: Asphalt 9, Mario Kart GP DX, MotoGP, Super Bikes 3, Halo Fireteam Raven, Jurassic Park Arcade, House of the Dead Scarlet Dawn. Updated 11/8/2025 on HOTD.
findings.note: Barcelona mall FEC; detailed ZIv list is racing/shooters/tickets only, no music games.

findings.name: Vista Al Puerto Restaurant
findings.evidence_quote: A restaurant with pool and football tables. Games: Ghost Squad, Football Table, Pool Table.
findings.note: Ibiza restaurant hotel complex; ZIv 2014 only. No rhythm inventory found. Stale source.

findings.name: Megazone
findings.evidence_quote: In the Groove 2 (North America) Dedicab. Doubles premium... Has r21 installed with custom songs enabled. SEK 10.00 for 3 songs.
findings.note: ITG2 is a dance rhythm game but not a named valid slug (not stepmaniax/ddr); mapped to other. Also listed on insert-coin.app for Megazone Norrland AB. No Konami/SEGA online rhythm.

findings.name: American Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: In the Groove 2 (North America) Comment: Upgraded Euromix Cab with Large LCD screen. Condition Unknown.
findings.note: ITG2 only music entry; last ZIv update 2024, condition unknown. Map as other.

findings.name: EuroAirport
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Cruis'n Blast (International) only.
findings.note: Airport racing cab only; no rhythm evidence.

findings.name: FUN4ALL
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Asphalt 9 Legends Arcade DX; Super Bikes 3; Time Crisis 5.
findings.note: Bowling Sevaz site (bowlingsevaz.ch); ZIv list is racing/shooter only.

findings.name: Flon Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: PIU XX was sold to a Genevan bowling. (Earlier historical: ITG pads... only public ITG cab in Switzerland.) Current Games: No games at this location. Picture titled Pump remains.
findings.note: Pump and ITG historically present but Pump sold per 2024 comment; current ZIv games empty. Treat as no remaining tracked rhythm on site.

findings.name: FriBowling
findings.evidence_quote: The piu XX has been moved somewhere else in switzerland. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Former PIU XX relocated; no remaining rhythm listed as of Mar 2026.

findings.name: Funplanet Brig
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Fun Planet chain offers arcade games at other CH sites (Rennaz etc.) per press; Brig entry empty.
findings.note: Chain FEC with bowling/laser/arcade brand-wide; Brig ZIv has no cab list. Not enough for confirmed_none.

findings.name: GamePlaza
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade Cabinets list includes Dance Dance Revolution X and Guitar hero. ZIv also lists In the Groove running on DDR X cabinet and Guitar Hero Arcade (free play museum).
findings.note: Interactive video game museum Zurich Altstetten. Official site lists DDR X; ZIv lists ITG on DDR X hardware + Guitar Hero Arcade. Guitar Hero/ITG mapped to other.

findings.name: San Francisco Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: Danz Base (China) Music Game. Condition Unknown. Price ???.
findings.note: Chinese dance cab (Danz Base); not a named valid slug. Presence last noted 2023.

findings.name: Shoot Again Fribourg
findings.evidence_quote: Club de flippers romand. Decouvrez le premier Club de flippers. Machines are pinball; no arcade rhythm games described.
findings.note: Pinball club only (Wix site). ZIv empty games list aligns.

findings.name: The Bowling Muntelier
findings.evidence_quote: Games: OutRun 2; Deadstorm Pirates; Ghost Squad Evolution.
findings.note: Bowling with racing/shooters only on ZIv.

findings.name: youcinema Oftringen
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Wangan Midnight MAXIMUM TUNE 3 (2P); Time Crisis 4.
findings.note: Cinema arcade racing/shooter only.

findings.name: Big City (大城市)
findings.evidence_quote: This location no longer has any rhythm games and is now entirely dedicated to various gambling machines. Comment: If you're in the area and want to play rhythm games, go to New City (id=1921).
findings.note: Zhongli 中央西路一段98號. Taiko wiki lists as 撤機店鋪. Still licensed electronic parlor (金大) but rhythm moved to nearby 新都市. Not on maimai DX International locator.

findings.name: FamilyMart
findings.evidence_quote: Yes, as in the Japanese supermarket chain. They're only here because they have PriChan. Games: Kiratto☆Pri Chan.
findings.note: Convenience store Pri Chan cab only; not a tracked Konami/SEGA rhythm slug. Mapped to other. Checheng Pingtung.

findings.name: Wen-ren Stationary Kingdom
findings.evidence_quote: A stationary store... has PriChan. Games: Kiratto☆Pri Chan.
findings.note: Kaohsiung stationery shop with Pri Chan only; mapped to other.

findings.name: 大魯閣保齡球 土城館 (Taroko Bowling Alley Tucheng Branch)
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Initial D Arcade Stage 8 Infinity Comment: 2 cabs. Perfect. taikoinfotw lists 大魯閣土城館 under 撤機 for 太鼓之達人13.
findings.note: Active bowling branch (trk.com.tw, FB posts 2026). Racing only on ZIv; taiko removed; not on maimai DX TW locator.

findings.name: 樂吉獅歡樂世界
findings.evidence_quote: maimai FiNALE (Asia) NT$20.00 for 3 songs Perfect. ScanL 2024: singular staff said other rhythm games were moved; this place is definitely on the way out.
findings.note: ATT筷食尚 桃園中正路47號4F. Offline FiNALE not on ALL.Net maimai DX International Taiwan list (2026). Historical maimai presence strong (FB/IG); current status may be closed or stripped. Slug maimai_dx used for series; not DX International.

findings.name: Amaze Me @ Asiatique the Riverfront
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Dance Live (International) Perfect. Also basketball, boxing, hockey. Mainly VR games but also had some arcade games.
findings.note: Dance Live is a generic dance rhythm cab; mapped to other. Not on TH maimai DX locator (6 EX10/ECHO/GIGA only).

findings.name: BUDDYLAND Plearnary Mall
findings.evidence_quote: Now only crane games left. Other games are gone. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Crane-only remaining; positive no non-crane arcade/rhythm left.

findings.name: Buddyland Porto Chino Mahachai
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Cruis'n Blast; Aliens: Extermination; Basketball Machine (2 cabinets).
findings.note: Racing/shooter/sports only; no music games listed.

findings.name: CN Wonderland Big C Future Park Rangsit
findings.evidence_quote: Games table: Claw Machine only. Picture still titled maimai FiNALE cab. Updated 2026-07-05.
findings.note: Ambiguous: photo label implies past/present FiNALE but current games section only claw. Not on ALL.Net TH maimai DX list. Do not invent presence.

findings.name: CN Wonderland Big C Place Ratchadaphisek
findings.evidence_quote: maimai FiNALE (Japan) Near stairs. Refurbished Chinese cab, Offline running on version 1.99B... Condition: Not Working. Picture: maimai FiNALE cab.
findings.note: Cab listed but Not Working as of 2026-06. Offline FiNALE not DX International (TH official list is 6 other venues). Slug maimai_dx for series.

findings.name: Echo Karaoke @ Sunee Shopping Centre, Ubon Ratchathani
findings.evidence_quote: Information: Pump It Up 2015 cab. 1 token per play. 3 hearts. 1 token is 10 baht. Games table empty.
findings.note: PIU 2015 noted in location info only; no games-table entry and no 2025+ reconfirm. Ubon provincial Echo, not Bangkok ALL.Net maimai sites.

findings.name: FUN PAVILION @ Big C Saphan Mai
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Some button are hard to press. THB 20.00 for 1 song. Condition Bad. Photos of Guitar Hero cab.
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade only music entry; map as other.

findings.name: FUN STATION @ Center One Shopping Plaza
findings.evidence_quote: There are some racing & shooting games. Most cabinet are broken. Games: Cruis'n Blast; Overtake - The Elite Challenge.
findings.note: Fresh July 2026 visit; racing only.

findings.name: FUN STATION @ Major Ratchayothin
findings.evidence_quote: Mainly clawing machines, had some cabinets for kids. Games: Cruis'n Blast; Terminator Salvation (Standard).
findings.note: Claw/kids + racing/shooter; no music games.

findings.name: Fun City Central Khonkaen Campus
findings.evidence_quote: Opened May 20th, 2026. Games: Treasure Cove, Sea Monsters, Walking Dead, Marvel Avengers Coin Pusher, Sky Garden, ZOMBIE TRAPPER, Basketball, Hockey. No music games.
findings.note: New Hahama Fun City; redemption/shooter/sports inventory only.

findings.name: Fun City Central Northville
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Treasure Cove, Ace Angler Version 2, Emoji Roller, Sky Garden, Space Invaders Counter Attack, Sweet Land 5. Updated 2026-07-28.
findings.note: Hahama FEC redemption/fishing only; no rhythm.

findings.name: Fun Pavilion Big C Chiang Rai 2 Airport
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Photos show pavilion and karaoke side / Marshmallow area.
findings.note: Empty cab list but photos of a game area; no positive none statement. Honest unknown.

findings.name: Fun Pavilion Esplanade Ngamwongwan - Khae Rai
findings.evidence_quote: Replaced Panda & echo Karaoke about late 2025. Games: Street Fighter IV, Mario Kart GP DX, Storm Rider, Walking Dead, Transformers HA, Basketball, Hockey.
findings.note: No music games in post-rebuild inventory. (Bangkok maimai DX lives at other operators: EX10/ECHO/GIGA.)

findings.name: Fun Station Zpell @ Future Park Rangsit
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Batman, Cruis'n Blast, Deadstorm Pirates, Deadstorm Special, Night Hunter, Ultimate Big Punch, Hockey. maimai DX at same mall is ECHO GAMES(ZPELL) on ALL.Net (separate operator).
findings.note: This Fun Station branch has no music games; do not attach ECHO Zpell maimai to this sid.

findings.name: Joyliday & Joymart Fashion Island
findings.evidence_quote: Most of cabinet are made for kids and most of claw machines, But there are some shooting games. Long inventory of redemption/shooters/sports; no music games. Updated 2026-07-27.
findings.note: Family Amusement Thailand; kids/claws/shooters only.

findings.name: Joyliday ICS
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Danz Base SEA Edition offline. THB 20 per player 2 songs. Photo: Danz Base and Some tables game.
findings.note: Danz Base SEA is Chinese dance rhythm; map as other. Also Jungle Drummer (not a valid slug).

findings.name: Joyliday Megabangna
findings.evidence_quote: This arcade doesn't have a music rhythm game, but it has claw machines and some arcade games. Inventory: Mario Kart GP DX, Speed Rider 3, Ace Angler, Dragon Punch 2, Scooping Fun, Space Invaders Frenzy, Storm Shot, Street Basketball.
findings.note: Explicit positive statement of no music rhythm games.

findings.name: Joyliday Robinson Lifestyle Samutprakan
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Danz Base SEA Edition Offline Perfect. Updated 2026-07-20.
findings.note: Danz Base SEA offline; map as other.

findings.name: Joyliday The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi
findings.evidence_quote: Two branches (Harborland kids + MCC Hall main). Inventory: Treasure Cove, Asphalt 9 DX, Power Truck, Speed Rider 3, Jurassic Park, Monster Eye 2, Transformers HA, Ace Angler 8P, Dragon Punch, Lane Master, Scooping Fun, Power Hockey. No music games.
findings.note: Detailed dual-branch inventory without rhythm. Nearest official maimai is EX10 Ladprao (different venue).
